verdict.rationale: EFTPS publishes its availability window up front: payments can be made 24/7 (eftps-docs-2). It also publishes a hard cutoff: payments must be scheduled by 8 p.m. ET the day before the due date (eftps-supp-3), and the scheduling horizon is up to 365 days (eftps-docs-1). The evidence never mentions a session timeout or any per-day or per-transaction payment limit, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: published session-timeout duration, documented per-day/per-payment limits, and independent corroboration that these terms are shown before the user starts the flow.
